Pau Hana Wednesday (Outta Bounds)

Honolulu, HI · Diamond Head / Kahala

No-drop

Pau Hana Wednesday (Outta Bounds) is a road group ride in Honolulu, HI. It meets every Wednesday, 4:30 pm sharp, starting at Triangle Park (Fort Ruger Park), east of Diamond Head. Expect about 35 miles, fast, 18+ mph, regroup points and a designated sweeper.

About the Pau Hana Wednesday (Outta Bounds) group ride

A fast after-work ride from Diamond Head out toward Hanauma Bay, Sandy's or Makapu'u depending on the season. The pace is 18-plus but the route is fixed, there are regular regroups and a sweeper so nobody is left behind. Refreshments back at the park.

It's a no-drop ride. If you're slower than the group, someone waits. That's the whole point of a group ride.
